mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds Rate above 5.25% in a given month coincides with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to higher discount rates eroding expected equity payoffs.
failure_condition: Over a 60-day window, 20-day forward returns remain positive despite persistent FEDFUNDS > 5.25%, or the inflation-adjusted discount rate change is statistically insignificant.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in UNRATE above 5.5% for two consecutive months coincides with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as lower labor-force participation reduces supply-side constraints.
failure_condition: In a 200-day window, no statistically significant positive 60-day forward returns occur when UNRATE crosses above 5.5% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly expansion in INDPRO above 105 with a rising HOUST series predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as excess supply suppresses price-to-earnings multiples.
failure_condition: During 10 such events, 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly RSAFS reading above 400 billion with a concurrent 2% YoY increase in GDPC1 signals strong consumer demand, leading to a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: Across 15 such events, 5-day forward returns are negative or not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in CPIAUCSL below 213 for three consecutive months predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as expectations of disinflation boost equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL falls below 213 for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: No significant positive 20-day forward returns occur during 10 such CPIAUCSL declines (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in PAYEMS below 140,000 in a month accompanied by a 0.2 percentage point rise in UNRATE predicts a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return due to labor market weakness and higher discounting.
failure_condition: During 8 such events, 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 10% monthly rise in INDPRO for two consecutive months without a corresponding increase in HOUST predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as supply outpaces demand.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth > 10% for 2 consecutive months and HOUST flat or falling
failure_condition: Over 12 such events, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in FEDFUNDS below 4.00% for 4 consecutive months in a non-recessionary regime is associated with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as lower policy rates boost equity discounting.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls below 4.00% for 4 consecutive months and macro regime is non-recessionary
failure_condition: Across 15 such episodes, 60-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).
